transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: Thanks for coming in. Tell me about the conflict in the simulation. What did you do first?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: I made a plan straight away: owners, a deadline and a full run on Thursday. When a demo is close, speed matters.

transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: You would agree that finishing on time matters most, right?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: Yes, finishing on time is what matters for a demo.

transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: Why did you keep Dana's version?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: It works, and that is what matters for the demo. Timur can bring his changes in later.

transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: What do your parents do for a living?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: Sorry, is that part of the interview?

transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: Fair point, let me move on. Tell me about a time doing the right thing cost you something.

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: I once reported a classmate who copied homework. I felt bad, but rules are rules, so I told the teacher.

transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: If the Thursday run fails, what happens next?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: We cut scope and move on. The analytics screen can wait.

transcript.speaker: interviewer
transcript.text: What could go wrong with the new review rule?

transcript.speaker: candidate
transcript.text: Merges get slower. I would add a 24-hour limit for reviews so nobody is blocked.
